nodes.label: Exchange
nodes.meaning: General trading-network product containing hosting, inference offerings and project co-ownership trading.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Participant
nodes.meaning: A human or service participating in one or more explicit roles; a role is not automatically a stored account.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Buyer
nodes.meaning: Participant requesting an offering and accepting its terms.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Seller / Provider
nodes.meaning: Participant offering an outcome under explicit terms.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Host Operator
nodes.meaning: Participant configuring and operating engines or hosted services; distinct from the caller requesting their execution.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Offering
nodes.meaning: Discoverable description of a deliverable or executable outcome and its versioned terms.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Trade Terms
nodes.meaning: Versioned conditions identifying deliverable, evidence, deadlines, price/asset where applicable, commitment and recovery.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Order
nodes.meaning: Request bound to offering, parties and exact terms; paid purchase has its own implemented state machine.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Fulfillment
nodes.meaning: Offering-type-specific outcome or delivery satisfying a request.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Settlement
nodes.meaning: Durable commercial disposition under terms; inference usage measurement alone is not payment.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Exchange Host
nodes.meaning: Exchange capability for preparing, exposing, invoking, observing and controlling service revisions and configured engine bindings.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Principal
nodes.meaning: Authenticated human user or service.
nodes.boundary: Reuses approved inference structural model; application to the combined Exchange remains candidate.

nodes.label: Tenant
nodes.meaning: Flat isolation scope for memberships, permissions, configuration and request data.
nodes.boundary: Reuses approved inference structural model; application to the combined Exchange remains candidate.

nodes.label: Tenant Membership
nodes.meaning: Association of a principal with a tenant; association alone grants no inference permission.
nodes.boundary: Reuses approved inference structural model; application to the combined Exchange remains candidate.

nodes.label: Permission
nodes.meaning: Current resource/action/scope authorization distinct from membership or token possession.
nodes.boundary: Reuses approved inference structural model; application to the combined Exchange remains candidate.

nodes.label: Host Project
nodes.meaning: Host namespace containing source revisions, distinct from a project artifact offered for sale.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Service Revision
nodes.meaning: Immutable submitted source/build identity; build does not activate it.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Activation
nodes.meaning: Explicit selection of a prepared revision for a function; selection alone does not prove liveness.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Engine Binding
nodes.meaning: Operator-configured connection to a model runtime; excludes provider secrets from public discovery.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Invocation
nodes.meaning: Execution request against a service or model under explicit authorization and outcome rules.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.label: Observation
nodes.meaning: Recorded usage, health, status or attempt evidence with bounded meaning and freshness.
nodes.boundary: Candidate Exchange meaning; no canonical promotion.

nodes.boundary: Meaning owner remains KEP; no license, exclusive ownership or payment inferred.

nodes.label: Managed Alch Hosting
nodes.meaning: Paid Exchange service that accepts a supported Alch file and operates its callable realization for the customer.
nodes.boundary: Customer promise selected by user; supported profiles, commercial terms and runtime guarantees remain candidate.

invariants: KEP co-ownership preserves prior members and does not itself convey a license or payment.
A successful project Unlock atomically grants, pays and commits; expiry refunds only before commitment.
Decryption acknowledgement is bounded client evidence; absence after commitment does not undo settlement.
Build, activation, liveness, permission and commercial settlement are distinct facts.
Tenant membership alone grants no invocation; retained inference replay requires current permission.
Public discovery exposes declarations, not credentials or proof of engine readiness.
Unknown provider execution must not be treated as safe retry or zero usage.
